title: Looking for Alaska
author: John Green
summary: A quiet teenager enrols in an Alabama boarding school hoping to find a bigger life. He falls in with a group of pranksters and a captivating, unpredictable girl named Alaska.
readIf: you want a bittersweet teen novel about first love, friendship and how one day can divide your life.
skipIf: you want a light read, because this deals with sudden loss.

pairings.reason: The same author, with a similar teen search for a magnetic, elusive person.
Another honest, emotional story about finding your people at school.
An adult take on an intense boarding or college circle shaped by an unexplained loss.
